name: Style Library
statusNote: Canonical: if anything labelled Daybreak Editorial disagrees with this repo, the repo wins. The prior Glass Archive system is quarantined in legacy-glass-archive/, reference only.
oneLiner: The canonical Daybreak Editorial design system — three files that get copied into every personal project.
stack: Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, no package manager
Vanilla JS effects in one IIFE, file://-safe by design
Google Fonts (Space Grotesk, Inter, JetBrains Mono) — the only external dependency

components.name: tokens.css
components.desc: Single source of truth for CSS custom properties; tokens are never renamed.

components.name: style.css
components.desc: Reset, typography, paper grain, drifting sun, ink cursor, kinetic headline, depth cards, footer, reduced-motion override block.

components.name: effects.js
components.desc: One IIFE: kinetic headline, scroll reveal, count-up stats, card tilt, custom cursor, magnetic buttons, sun parallax — every branch checks reduced-motion first.

components.name: legacy-glass-archive/
components.desc: The retired prior system, quarantined — do not build new work from here.

dataFlow: Consuming HTML links Google Fonts, then tokens.css, then style.css — order enforced.
tokens.css defines root custom properties; style.css consumes them via var().
Page markup includes the required scaffolding elements inside the wrapper.
effects.js loads last, runs on DOMContentLoaded, and silently skips missing optional hooks.
Reduced-motion and hover:none are checked once at start; motion branches short-circuit to a static end-state.
Downstream, a human manually copies the three files into each consuming repo — no registry, no sync tooling.
integrations: The portfolio monorepo holds its own copied snapshot in styles/
decisions: One Goldenrod thread, locked, with an accent/accent-ink split for AA-safe text.
Depth cards are the signature component; the ✦ is the only ornament.
prefers-reduced-motion is absolute law — motion dies but cards stay in a static elevated state.
file://-safe by design: no fetch, no ES modules.
